name: acc-0016
description: Acceptance 0016: a VM rented with a requester-chosen image boots it and reports its marker; a wrong sha256 is refused before boot.

actions.label: Run 0016
actions.description: Rent with the image (input image {url, sha256} and marker): Held, /etc/swc-image is the marker, the toolchain answers, the release; then rent it again: the bidder does not fetch it a second time.

actions.label: Run 0016 bad sha
actions.description: Rent with the image's sha256 changed: no bidder takes it, the contract fails cleanly before any VM, nothing is held.

hooks.reason: the contract records RecordNotFound after the release
